integrity: Analytical proof of all-real-positive-parameter theorem, with independent stochastic uniformization checks on deterministic random samples; no independent external validation.
scientific_limitations: Only the three-state finite real birth-death semigroup and positive edge weights; no general higher-dimensional or discretized solver conclusions. Related indexed full texts were unavailable for complete priority comparison.
title: Single-peak transient variation amplification and exact recovery for three-state birth–death heat
